metadata.source: Nationale Woningbouwkaart / Landelijke Monitor Voortgang Woningbouw
metadata.sourceOwner: Ministerie van BZK; municipalities via provinces, processed by ABF Research
metadata.scope: Netherlands public housing-plan points where published; incomplete location inventory
limitations: Only public plans and supplied plan locations are included. No point does not mean no plan.
Municipalities do not all supply plan-location data; completeness differs between provinces.
Public plan points are currently absent for: Fryslân, Gelderland, Noord-Brabant.
Points mark published project locations, not cadastral boundaries, legal designations or permission.
Hard/soft plan status and planned dwelling capacity are snapshot attributes, not construction guarantees.
Peilmoment differs by source record; updates occur around January and July.
No rights can be derived from the data; verify the municipal source and current rules.
